title: Dell Technologies Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Dell Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K disclosure on April 20, 2026, reporting unregistered sales of equity securities: approximately 4.24 million shares of Class C common stock were issued upon conversion of the same number of Class B shares held by Silver Lake entities (SL SPV-2, L.P., Silver Lake Partners IV, L.P., Silver Lake Technology Investors IV, L.P., Silver Lake Partners V DE (AIV), L.P., and Silver Lake Technology Investors V, L.P.) across eight dates in March and April 2026. As of April 17, 2026, total Class C shares outstanding were approximately 325.7 million and Class B shares outstanding were approximately 47.8 million.
key_points: Conversion dates: March 2, March 4, March 17, March 18, March 20, March 23, April 15, and April 16, 2026
Total shares converted: 4,237,699 Class B to Class C common stock

Silver Lake entities are the converting holders: SL SPV-2, L.P., Silver Lake Partners IV, L.P., Silver Lake Technology Investors IV, L.P., Silver Lake Partners V DE (AIV), L.P., Silver Lake Technology Investors V, L.P.
As of April 17, 2026: 325,654,621 Class C shares and 47,789,758 Class B shares outstanding
Issuance relied on Section 3(a)(9) exemption under Securities Act of 1933; no commission or remuneration paid for solicitation
Class B shares convert to Class C on a one-to-one basis at holder's option or automatically upon certain transfers
